title: Physio Decision Models: Clinical Reasoning Under Biological Uncertainty
description: A formal epistemic structure for clinical reasoning in physiotherapy that treats every intervention as a hypothesis test under irreducible biological uncertainty. Defines six canonical decision outputs (DECLINE, DEFER, REFER, TRIAL, CONTINUE, DISCHARGE), objective continuation criteria, and explicit exit conditions, and 38 condition-specific decision guides with references to peer-reviewed literature. The framework is expert opinion and has not been clinically validated. Authored by Alejandro Zubrisky, BPT (Recovery TLV, Tel Aviv, Israel).
